prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready HD 2D fighting-game stage background, FAR LAYER of a parallax set, fully opaque.
Input images: Image 1 is a character of the game (Napoleon): match its clean hand-drawn HD line art, fluid inked contours, flat cel-shaded shadows and discreet gradients exactly, at background scale. Image 2 is the existing far layer of another stage of the same game (dusk funfair): match its level of detail, its rendering and its framing (horizon low, big sky), not its subject or palette.
Primary request: the battlefield of Austerlitz on a winter morning of 1805, seen from the French lines: the 'sun of Austerlitz' rising and breaking through a sea of fog in the valley, rolling snowy hills and the Pratzen heights in the distance, a small village with a church bell tower, frozen ponds, distant columns of smoke. Contents: (see above), plus leafless birch trees and windmills on a far ridge. Sky: dawn, cold steel blue-grey and lilac at the top, warm rose and pale golden-orange around the low sun on the right, long flat-shaded clouds.
Layout: landscape, as wide as possible (at least 2:1). The horizon / ground line lies at about 78% of the image height; the lowest 22% is plain ground that will be hidden by the other layers. The middle third of the width, at the height of the fighters (between 35% and 75% of the image height), stays calm: medium values, no bright spot, no strong vertical line right in the centre.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no animals, no readable text, letters, numbers, signs or logos, no brand names, no UI, no frame, no checkerboard drawn in, no watermark. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic.
codexInstructions: Instructions for you (Codex): generate this image with your image generation tool, at the widest landscape size it supports. Save the PNG exactly at <source> (create nothing else, modify no other file). Do not post-process the image in any way (no crop, no resize, no mirror, no colour change). Then print the pixel dimensions. If the result is not landscape or contains text, regenerate once.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready HD 2D fighting-game stage layer, MIDDLE LAYER of a parallax set, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
Input images: Image 1 is the far background layer of this same stage: match its palette, light direction, horizon and rendering exactly; this middle layer will be drawn in front of it. Image 2 is a character of the game: match its clean hand-drawn HD line art, fluid inked contours, flat cel-shaded shadows and discreet gradients exactly, at background scale.
Primary request: a French imperial army bivouac at the edge of the battlefield, seen straight from the front: Contents: canvas army tents, two bronze field cannons with wooden wheels, stacked muskets in pyramids, military drums, supply wagons, ammunition crates, barrels, campfires with thin smoke, a tall flag pole carrying a plain tricolour flag without any emblem or text, snow on the canvas and on the ground line. All of it stands on one common straight ground line at the very bottom of the image. Muted olive, dark brown, dull bronze, off-white canvas and snow. No saturated colours, no grey-blue greatcoats, no gold (the fighters wear these colours).
Layout: landscape, as wide as possible (at least 2:1). The elements fill the full width from edge to edge with no gap, so the strip can be cropped on either side. Their tops reach between 35% and 60% of the image height with an irregular skyline; everything above them is fully transparent, so the far layer shows through. The lower part (behind the fighters' bodies) must stay calm and readable: medium-dark values, low contrast, muted desaturated colours, no bright spots or busy patterns at mid height.
Constraints: no characters, no people, no animals, no readable text, letters, numbers, signs or logos, no brand names, no UI, no frame, no checkerboard drawn in, no watermark. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic. No ground plane in front of the elements, no cast shadow on the ground.
codexInstructions: Instructions for you (Codex): generate this image with your image generation tool, at the widest landscape size it supports, with a true transparent background. Save the PNG exactly at <source> (create nothing else, modify no other file). Do not post-process the image in any way (no crop, no resize, no mirror, no threshold, no colour change). Then print the pixel dimensions and whether the four corners are fully transparent. If the result is not landscape, is opaque or contains text, regenerate once.
